scope: Compiled Compact simulator and public-VM transcript replay; no proof generation, proof verification or node submission. Disclosure fixture scans and paired transcripts are regression checks, not a proof of zero-knowledge.

checks.name: dormant account refuses authorization
bootstrap binds key, policy and initial private opening
activation installs one account-bound private credential
bootstrap cannot be reused
last credential cannot be removed
enrolment adds precisely one independent key
after device use, different salt, policy and slot cannot re-register its key
unregistered key cannot authorize with a valid signature
policy label is authenticated by the committed record
invalid signature is refused
wrong root opening and altered roster cannot authorize
inactive slots have a single canonical representation
malformed duplicate rows are rejected independently of their commitment
two signers in different slots have identical public authorization transcripts
authorization is single-use despite an unchanged registry root
enrolment cannot alter another credential or insert two keys
enrolment signature binds the proposed commitment and blinding
identity key cannot be enrolled
authorising credential survives every selective removal
unknown removal target is refused
removal cannot mutate the surviving record
removal signature binds its target and next commitment
selective removal works after repeated target use without a counter
old roster cannot resurrect a revoked credential
remaining device needs refreshed private data after a registry change
fresh authorised re-enrolment is explicit and does not replay old approvals
account binding rejects a roster transplanted from another account
fresh root blinding changes the commitment for identical private records
diagnostic recovery requires its separate recovery signature
diagnostic recovery replaces the whole registry without its old opening
pre-recovery roster cannot authorize at the new epoch
capacity is bounded and overflow cannot overwrite a live record
